nodes.title: prompt A
widgets_values:
Wide shot, dynamic low-angle camera, cinematic composition. A lone female samurai floats mid-air in a futuristic cyberpunk metropolis. She hovers at 1km altitude, suspended between colossal 5km-tall megastructures, intricate intertwining architectural frameworks, and dense urban canyons.
The woman has porcelain-white skin, long flowing violet hair, and a crimson mask covering the lower half of her face. Her body is encased in a high-tech spacesuit. 
She wields a katana that crackles with violet energy field. The cityscape around her is a vertical maze of hyper-complex mega-structures, layered frameworks, and neon-lit industrial gantries.

Color palette:  vibrant magenta #ff1990, cyan #19c6ff,bright yellow #f9ff62,lime green #23ee96,soft teal #cee8e9,deep purple #ac5fed,muted steel #4f4f5b,neon orange #ff7e00.
Dominant color: #000837.
